chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama'ah, from Ibn Muskan, from Sulayman ibn Khalid, from Abi 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
The 'Asr prayer is at two cubits, so whoever leaves it until it reaches six feet, then that is the one who is neglectful.

key_terms.الْمُضَيِّعُ: the one who neglects or wastes the proper time
key_terms.ذِرَاعَيْنِ: two cubits, indicating a time measure based on shadow length
key_terms.سِتَّةِ أَقْدَامٍ: six feet, indicating a later time measure based on shadow length

ai.seo_question: Until what point may the 'Asr prayer be delayed before a person is considered negligent?
ai.summary: This hadith concerns the timing of the 'Asr prayer and warns against delaying it excessively. It identifies a point of blameworthy delay, marking such a person as negligent regarding the proper observance of salat (prayer).
